title: Renamed passage conversations
description: On stdout, once, right after `renamed_authoring`, when --rename-course is given: how many passage conversations (RFC 6 §5.2) now name `to`, 0 when there were none. Their questions and replies name the conversation, not the course. Separate from the earlier renamed lines, whose schemas are unchanged.

kind.description: The program that printed the line.

run.description: One id per invocation, on every line it prints.

at.description: When the line was printed, UTC.

conversations.description: Passage conversation rows that were renamed.
